options.label: Collections first (current proposal)
options.rationale: Prioritize invoice eligibility and the temporary cash mechanism before service and pricing gates.
options.challenge: Earlier collections work does not advance the assumed January collection date; service approval is delayed.

options.label: Pricing first
options.rationale: Reserve finance review for renewal eligibility first, retaining all original economic effective dates and commitments.
options.challenge: Earlier readiness does not override contract/economic start dates; service approval is pushed later.

options.label: Service first
options.rationale: Reserve service validation and acceptance first; schedule remaining finance work into available capacity.
options.challenge: Modeled advantage depends on a verifiable vendor cost action and safe service quality; freed hours alone are not earnings.

brief.conditional_choice_reason: Among these three authored sequences, service-first restores the original base-case service start and leaves pricing and collections ready before their assumed economic dates. Prefer it only in the constructed exercise and only if the vendor cost action and quality gate can be evidenced. This is not a recommendation to deploy automation at Progress or a proof of optimality.
reopen_choice_if: No committed vendor reduction or quality-safe service mechanism: withdraw the service benefit and reforecast with committed costs retained.
Resource availability differs from the proposed budgets: re-run scheduling and reconsider the sequence.
Contract eligibility, retention response or original collection dates differ: revise the economic assumptions, not just the task order.

assessments.question: Does reported growth demonstrate improvement in the pre-ShareFile business?
assessments.rationale: The disclosed ShareFile contribution increase exceeds consolidated revenue growth. The remaining decline merits explanation before a recovery thesis is underwritten.
assessments.mechanism: Separate perimeter changes from price, volume, renewal timing and currency.
assessments.population: Consolidated FY2024/FY2025 revenue, with ShareFile removed arithmetically.
evidence_needed: Product-level revenue bridge on a constant perimeter
assessments.falsification_or_reopen_test: Reject a structural deterioration or recovery claim if a reconciled timing/perimeter bridge explains the residual without an underlying change; retain any unresolved remainder.

assessments.question: Can the license decline justify a broad price-book migration?
assessments.rationale: The public figures do not establish eligible contracts, enforceable uplifts or net retention economics.
assessments.mechanism: Test price realization only within comparable, contractually eligible renewal cohorts.
assessments.population: No verified customer cohort is available.
evidence_needed: Contracts, notice periods, caps and channel terms
Matched invoices, concessions, quantities and renewal outcomes
Churn and contribution margin by eligible cohort
assessments.falsification_or_reopen_test: Reject the price intervention if the apparent gap disappears after mix/quantity adjustments, contracts prohibit it, or lost contribution and implementation costs exceed the uplift.

assessments.question: Can ending ShareFile transition services create new savings?
assessments.rationale: The disclosed agreement already ended in Q2 FY2025. Treating its termination as a new intervention would count an existing action again.
assessments.mechanism: Remove a continuing transition-service obligation only if it still exists.
alternative_explanations: Post-TSA replacement costs may continue under different arrangements
evidence_needed: A separately documented continuing obligation and current approved budget, if any
assessments.falsification_or_reopen_test: Reopen only for a distinct, documented remaining obligation with an owner, termination right and incremental cost action; never reuse the completed TSA termination.

assessments.question: Can acquisition costs establish an automation or integration savings pool?
assessments.rationale: Consolidated cost growth and acquisition revenue do not identify removable operating costs or standalone acquired earnings.
assessments.mechanism: Link a specific workflow or duplicate obligation to a safe operating change and an actual spend action.
assessments.population: No verified ticket, staffing, vendor or duplicate-cost population is available.
alternative_explanations: Costs may support a larger acquired business
Integrated shared costs may remain after process changes
Costs may already be removed in the baseline
evidence_needed: Reconciled cost center and vendor ledger
Ticket volumes, quality constraints and staffing commitments
Existing integration plan and actions already in the budget
assessments.falsification_or_reopen_test: Reject if safe capacity release does not permit a supported spend action, quality deteriorates, or the same cost is already removed or claimed elsewhere.

original_financials.cash_definition: Incremental pre-tax operating cash proxy; excludes tax, financing, nonmodeled working-capital accounts and terminal settlements shown separately.
original_financials.valuation_definition: Year-two incremental recurring contribution multiplied by an assumed sensitivity multiple. Temporary implementation expense is excluded explicitly; no maintainability review, fair-value estimate, total company EV or equity proceeds is implied.
original_financials.multiple_rationale: Arbitrary 6x/8x/10x sensitivity grid to demonstrate valuation dependence; not sourced comparable-company multiples or a fair-value range.
original_financials.timing_convention: Benefits accrue ratably by calendar day, using differences of rounded cumulative accruals to conserve cents; costs and cash occur on explicit dates. Day 100 includes the start date. Funding uses dated cash movements; recovery is the first nonnegative cumulative balance after the final modeled deficit, within the 24-month horizon only.

scheduled_financials.cash_definition: Incremental pre-tax operating cash proxy; excludes tax, financing, nonmodeled working-capital accounts and terminal settlements shown separately.
scheduled_financials.valuation_definition: Year-two incremental recurring contribution multiplied by an assumed sensitivity multiple. Temporary implementation expense is excluded explicitly; no maintainability review, fair-value estimate, total company EV or equity proceeds is implied.
scheduled_financials.multiple_rationale: Arbitrary 6x/8x/10x sensitivity grid to demonstrate valuation dependence; not sourced comparable-company multiples or a fair-value range.
scheduled_financials.timing_convention: Benefits accrue ratably by calendar day, using differences of rounded cumulative accruals to conserve cents; costs and cash occur on explicit dates. Day 100 includes the start date. Funding uses dated cash movements; recovery is the first nonnegative cumulative balance after the final modeled deficit, within the 24-month horizon only.

original_financials.timing_convention: Benefits accrue ratably by calendar day, using differences of rounded cumulative accruals to conserve cents; costs and cash occur on explicit dates. scheduled_financials.valuation_definition: Year-two incremental recurring contribution multiplied by an assumed sensitivity multiple. Temporary implementation expense is excluded explicitly; no maintainability review, fair-value estimate, total company EV or equity proceeds is implied.
scheduled_financials.multiple_rationale: Arbitrary 6x/8x/10x sensitivity grid to demonstrate valuation dependence; not sourced comparable-company multiples or a fair-value range.
scheduled_financials.timing_convention: Benefits accrue ratably by calendar day, using differences of rounded cumulative accruals to conserve cents; costs and cash occur on explicit dates. Day 100 includes the start date. Funding uses dated cash movements; recovery is the first nonnegative cumulative balance after the final modeled deficit, within the 24-month horizon only.

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative monthly renewal cohort; not extracted or inferred from Progress contracts.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Contract-level eligibility and revenue reconciliation differ.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed permissible price uplift before capture and incremental churn.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Notice periods, caps or competitor pricing prevent the uplift.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed share of the uplift captured after concessions; not a success probability.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Signed renewal economics show lower net capture.

assumptions.rationale: Incremental lost revenue relative to the otherwise unchanged counterfactual cohort.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Retention/mix evidence cannot isolate this loss or shows a larger loss.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed genuinely variable servicing cost, including the symmetric cost reduction on lost revenue.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Costs are fixed or cannot adjust with cohort revenue.

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative monthly contact population; no actual Progress ticket data.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Ticket scope, seasonality or data quality differs.

assumptions.rationale: Eligible share of constructed contacts.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Safety or complexity exclusions reduce the eligible population.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed successful resolution after recontacts; not raw chatbot containment.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Evaluation or repeat-contact measurement fails.

assumptions.rationale: Twelve net handling minutes per eligible successful contact.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Time study shows shifted work or less net time avoided.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed avoidable vendor cost per hour, not salary converted automatically to savings.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Vendor commitments or minimums prevent expense removal.

assumptions.rationale: Explicit monthly vendor-spend action, capped by avoided work and addressable spend; zero in downside.
assumptions.invalidated_by: No approved contract reduction or spend reduction is available.

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative monthly renewal cohort; not extracted or inferred from Progress contracts.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Contract-level eligibility and revenue reconciliation differ.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed permissible price uplift before capture and incremental churn.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Notice periods, caps or competitor pricing prevent the uplift.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed share of the uplift captured after concessions; not a success probability.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Signed renewal economics show lower net capture.

assumptions.rationale: Incremental lost revenue relative to the otherwise unchanged counterfactual cohort.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Retention/mix evidence cannot isolate this loss or shows a larger loss.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed genuinely variable servicing cost, including the symmetric cost reduction on lost revenue.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Costs are fixed or cannot adjust with cohort revenue.

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative monthly contact population; no actual Progress ticket data.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Ticket scope, seasonality or data quality differs.

assumptions.rationale: Eligible share of constructed contacts.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Safety or complexity exclusions reduce the eligible population.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed successful resolution after recontacts; not raw chatbot containment.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Evaluation or repeat-contact measurement fails.

assumptions.rationale: Twelve net handling minutes per eligible successful contact.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Time study shows shifted work or less net time avoided.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed avoidable vendor cost per hour, not salary converted automatically to savings.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Vendor commitments or minimums prevent expense removal.

assumptions.rationale: Explicit monthly vendor-spend action, capped by avoided work and addressable spend; zero in downside.
assumptions.invalidated_by: No approved contract reduction or spend reduction is available.

assumptions.rationale: Constructed monthly expense pool bounding modeled cost removal.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Reconciled eligible spend is lower.

assumptions.rationale: Constructed existing receivables; no new sales or bad-debt recovery assumed.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Subledger reconciliation, terms or disputes do not support the balance.

assumptions.rationale: Share collected early; incremental cash reverses on the counterfactual collection date.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Balances are uncollectible or would already have been paid.

assumptions.rationale: Temporary implementation expense paid before benefits; scenario-specific overrun included.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Vendor scope or implementation staffing changes.

assumptions.rationale: Monthly platform, QA and vendor fee from kickoff, including delayed/failed benefit months.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Signed fees, usage or QA requirements differ.

assumptions.rationale: Monthly governance and analysis expense from kickoff.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Required operator effort or tooling changes.

assumptions.rationale: Committed shared data foundation expense retained even if all initiatives are excluded.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Commitment can actually be canceled before payment.

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative capitalized implementation outlay; not deducted again in EBITDA.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Accounting review requires expense classification or a different asset amount.

assumptions.rationale: Authored higher-uplift alternative; contractual caps, retention and feasibility still constrain the case.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Notice periods, caps or competitor pricing prevent the uplift.

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative monthly renewal cohort; not extracted or inferred from Progress contracts.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Contract-level eligibility and revenue reconciliation differ.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed permissible price uplift before capture and incremental churn.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Notice periods, caps or competitor pricing prevent the uplift.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed share of the uplift captured after concessions; not a success probability.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Signed renewal economics show lower net capture.

assumptions.rationale: Incremental lost revenue relative to the otherwise unchanged counterfactual cohort.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Retention/mix evidence cannot isolate this loss or shows a larger loss.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed genuinely variable servicing cost, including the symmetric cost reduction on lost revenue.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Costs are fixed or cannot adjust with cohort revenue.

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative monthly contact population; no actual Progress ticket data.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Ticket scope, seasonality or data quality differs.

assumptions.rationale: Eligible share of constructed contacts.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Safety or complexity exclusions reduce the eligible population.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed successful resolution after recontacts; not raw chatbot containment.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Evaluation or repeat-contact measurement fails.

assumptions.rationale: Twelve net handling minutes per eligible successful contact.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Time study shows shifted work or less net time avoided.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed avoidable vendor cost per hour, not salary converted automatically to savings.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Vendor commitments or minimums prevent expense removal.

assumptions.rationale: Explicit monthly vendor-spend action, capped by avoided work and addressable spend; zero in downside.
assumptions.invalidated_by: No approved contract reduction or spend reduction is available.

assumptions.rationale: Constructed monthly expense pool bounding modeled cost removal.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Reconciled eligible spend is lower.

assumptions.rationale: Constructed existing receivables; no new sales or bad-debt recovery assumed.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Subledger reconciliation, terms or disputes do not support the balance.

assumptions.rationale: Share collected early; incremental cash reverses on the counterfactual collection date.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Balances are uncollectible or would already have been paid.

assumptions.rationale: Temporary implementation expense paid before benefits; scenario-specific overrun included.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Vendor scope or implementation staffing changes.

assumptions.rationale: Monthly platform, QA and vendor fee from kickoff, including delayed/failed benefit months.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Signed fees, usage or QA requirements differ.

assumptions.rationale: Monthly governance and analysis expense from kickoff.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Required operator effort or tooling changes.

assumptions.rationale: Committed shared data foundation expense retained even if all initiatives are excluded.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Commitment can actually be canceled before payment.

scheduled_financials.cash_definition: Incremental pre-tax operating cash proxy; excludes tax, financing, nonmodeled working-capital accounts and terminal settlements shown separately.
scheduled_financials.limitation: Constructed source records belong to one economic pool each. Fixed population shares also allocate QA, vendor spend and vendor minimums before rates and caps; exclusions, failed gates and missing evidence never redistribute shares. Source records replace the reference exposure rather than adding to it. This is a prospective forecast, not measured company impact, causal attribution or maintainable exit earnings.

scheduled_financials.cash_definition: Incremental pre-tax operating cash proxy; excludes tax, financing, nonmodeled working-capital accounts and terminal settlements shown separately.
scheduled_financials.limitation: Constructed source records belong to one economic pool each. Fixed population shares also allocate QA, vendor spend and vendor minimums before rates and caps; exclusions, failed gates and missing evidence never redistribute shares. Source records replace the reference exposure rather than adding to it. This is a prospective forecast, not measured company impact, causal attribution or maintainable exit earnings.

source_review.recommendation: Reopen first-wave selection: every tested sequence has nonpositive base year-one EBITDA after the corrected source constraints and retained costs. Changing task order does not repair the business case.
source_review.source_treatment: Each alternative keeps the latest underwriting assumptions, source rows, resources, work packages and costs. Only priority order and its resulting dates change; source-book plan hashes are explicitly rebound to each hypothetical schedule. Original priorities follow the explicitly recorded split/merge task ancestry to current packages.
source_review.authority: Derived research challenge, not a new case revision or operating approval. A receipt for the stored case does not accept these recomputed alternatives. Constructed exercise dates do not change the public-filing information cutoff; this is not a historical point-in-time forecast.

authority: Research-author judgment and constructed operating exercise; no company participation, management approval, independent practitioner review or actual financial result.
valuation_limit: Constructed year-two incremental EV sensitivities are separate from the historical company EV-to-equity sensitivity. Neither establishes current equity value, transaction proceeds or sourced market multiples; fictional operating uplift is never added to company earnings.
